mechanisms.name: cooling rate effect on grain size

evidence.quote: The as-cast microstructure of Ti-6Al-4V alloy is largely affected by the section size as it directly affects the cooling rate. Thicker sections or locations near risers or gates with lower cooling rates will result in larger grains.

Regardless of differences in the section sizes, the fracture morphologies of all specimens show small and dense dimples. This indicates that the fracture mechanism is characterized by ductile fracture.

The most influential microstructural parameter on the mechanical properties of fully lamellar structures is the colony size because it determines the effective slip length. Both the yield strength and ductility decrease with an increase in slip length.

The as-cast microstructure of Ti-6Al-4V alloy is largely affected by the section size as it directly affects the cooling rate. Thicker sections or locations near risers or gates with lower cooling rates will result in larger grains.

The most influential microstructural parameter on the mechanical properties of fully lamellar structures is the colony size because it determines the effective slip length. Both the yield strength and ductility decrease with an increase in slip length.

Regardless of differences in the section sizes, the fracture morphologies of all specimens show small and dense dimples. This indicates that the fracture mechanism is characterized by ductile fracture.
